title: Fort Stanton (New Mexico)
geometryBasis: Used native OpenStreetMap ways 1119202324 and 306337103 at the south parade frontage, the National Register inventory and the original USGS Rio Hondo bare-earth survey.
sectionBasis: AllenS’s exact Qualla originals show the Adjutant’s Office's arcaded stone base, dark wood shingles, two-story porch and half-round dormer window, and the Second Guard House’s long single-story pale frontage and shallow entrance pediment.
limitations: The two standing south-parade buildings are represented. Rear elevations, roof pitches and small trim lengths are visual estimates.
The parade-ground landscape, barracks, officers’ quarters, other outbuildings and interiors are outside this model.
